entries.15f891e448c4eb31: This business manufactures and sells, mainly in Japan, edible oils for household and business use, processing oils and fats, meal (oil cake), as well as chocolate, dressings, and MCT-related foods. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥389,586 million (99.8% of the previous year), making it the largest reportable segment. In Oils, Fats and Oilseeds, prices were revised amid continued rises in raw material costs, but sales volumes declined, mainly for home-use products. In Processed Foods and Materials, revenue increased due to price revisions for chocolate.
entries.186e69cd277eb026: This business manufactures and sells processed oils and fats such as fats for chocolate, as well as business-use edible oil and processing oils and fats, in Malaysia and other overseas markets. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥138,848 million (120.3% of the previous year), an increase. Because cocoa bean prices soared in the previous fiscal year, demand rose for chocolate fats that can substitute for cocoa butter, and selling prices also rose as palm oil prices increased. The main business is conducted by consolidated subsidiary Intercontinental Specialty Fats Sdn. Bhd., and subsidiaries in Italy and Shanghai also handle processed oils and fats. This category was newly established from the fiscal year 2025, and figures for the previous year have been restated to the new category in disclosures.
